REBALANCED_SPIRE_EVENT_REFLECTIONS.pages: Choose at most [blue]13[/blue] cards in your [gold]Deck[/gold] to duplicate.

You stand still and stare into the reflection before you.
It stares back just as intently, without a trace of hesitation.

One by one, familiar shapes peel away from the mirror and slip into your hands.
[sine]Which one is reflecting which?[/sine]
REBALANCED_SPIRE_EVENT_SPIRALING_WHIRLPO: Obtain a random [gold]Uncommon Relic[/gold]. Add [red]Injury[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].

Foolishly, you plunge your arm into the center of the [aqua][sine]Spiraling Whirlpool[/sine][/aqua], disrupting the equilibrium. The water becomes [blue][jitter]frigid[/jitter][/blue] and grasps you, carving [jitter][red]Invisible Spirals[/red][/jitter] into your arm.

Your fingers brush against something solid, and you grasp around in pain to finally wrestle a [gold]Relic[/gold] out of there!
REBALANCED_SPIRE_EVENT_SPIRIT_GRAFTER.pa:
On instinct, you draw your weapon and lash out at the charging [orange]Spirit Grafter[/orange].

[gold]Light[/gold] and [red]flame[/red] burst in midair as your blow cleaves through its advance, forcing it back with a [jitter][purple]sharp, strangled shriek[/purple][/jitter]. The spirit circles around you for a few moments, seemingly unwilling to give up, yet no longer daring to come close again.

At last, it slips into the darkness with a trail of [sine]smoldering resentment[/sine], and vanishes.
REBALANCED_SPIRE_EVENT_WELCOME_TO_WONGOS:
"Um... excuse me, you can't just leave without buying something at Wongo's." says the clerk with an irritated tone.

Before you can protest, they shove an armful of heavy flyers and miscellaneous samples into you, then roughly hustle you out the door, leaving you [jitter][red]battered[/red][/jitter].

You vow to never return to a Wongo's.
WELCOME_TO_WONGOS.loss: {character} vowed to never return to a Wongo's.
